children: Novo Nordisk A/S Sponsored ADR Class B (OMXCOP:NOVO_B) is advancing obesity and metabolic drugs—filing an NDA, reporting strong CagriSema and Wegovy liver‑fat data and licensing HRS‑1596—while managing manufacturing remediation, buybacks, pricing deals and awaiting U.S. antitrust and FDA clearance.
Previous Week Recap
Novo Nordisk A/S Sponsored ADR Class B Licensed Global Rights
: NOVO_B licensed global rights (ex-China) to HRS-1596, a once‑weekly oral GLP‑1/GIP dual agonist for weight and T2D; deal includes upfront, milestones, royalties and awaits U.S. antitrust clearance.
CagriSema 52-Week Trials Show Weight Loss
: Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B): EASD 2026 CagriSema 52-week trials show ~22–23% mean weight loss vs placebo, reduced cravings/hunger, fMRI lower response to high-calorie cues, less abdominal/organ fat.
Indirect Comparison: Zepbound Tops Wegovy
: Indirect comparison showed Lilly’s Zepbound 15 mg and 10 mg outperformed Novo Nordisk’s Wegovy 7.2 mg in weight-loss at 72 weeks; NOVO_B dipped about 1.3% in premarket trading.
NDA Filed for Obesity Drug; FDA Q4 2026
: NOVO_B filed an NDA for an obesity drug with FDA in Dec 2025; FDA decision expected Q4 2026. Stock was reported up 0.93% at $38.67 at that time.
Manufacturing Site Issues: Remediation Matter
: Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B) says manufacturing site issues are a facility remediation matter; no clinical efficacy or safety data flagged. 2025 rare blood-disorder sales ~DKK 12.0B; group sales DKK 309B.
Share Buyback Of B Shares
: Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B) repurchased 35,379,179 B shares through its buyback launched May 6, 2026, at an average DKK 280.95 per share, totaling DKK 9.94 billion.
Wegovy Reduces Liver Fat Significantly
: Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B): pooled STEP UP analyses show Wegovy cut mean liver fat from 8.8% to 3.1% at Week 72; 88.5% (23/26) with baseline >5% dropped below 5%.
Semaglutide 2.4 mg For MASH Trials
: Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B) is testing semaglutide 2.4 mg for metabolic dysfunction–associated steatohepatitis (MASH); Wegovy already has approvals for MASH in some markets.
STEP UP Data On Semaglutide Doses
: Pooled STEP UP data (1,919 adults) include exposure to semaglutide formulations tied to Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B): 1,312 got 7.2 mg, 304 got 2.4 mg, 303 placebo; >94% high fatty liver risk.
Most-Favored-Nation Pricing With Trump Admin
: Novo Nordisk (NOVO_B) struck a most-favored-nation pricing deal with the Trump administration that may exempt it from the GLOBE Medicare drug pricing model, which could apply to few manufacturers.
